CustomField.description: The record ID of the Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction this gift is mirrored to by the Gift Transaction mirror (BarnCRM Mirror). Text, not a lookup, so Mirror installs where Nonprofit Cloud does not exist (ADR-0013).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction this gift is mirrored to. Filled in by the Gift Transaction mirror. Paste an existing Gift Transaction's record ID to link to it, or clear it to have a new one made.
CustomField.label: Gift Transaction ID
